We have TEFA, so we’re in the fortunate (but overwhelming) position of being able to consider public, charter, or private schools, and I’d love recommendations from local parents.
My son is incredibly bright, curious, and learns quickly, but he likely has ADHD (currently in the diagnostic process) and some medical issues that can require frequent appointments or occasional health-related disruptions, so flexibility and understanding from the school are really important to us.
He’s also an only child and has some challenges with emotional regulation and social connection, so I want an environment that will support him with compassion rather than seeing him as a “problem kid.”
We had our hearts set on one school, but I recently learned it’s full Spanish immersion, and I worry that adding a second language while he’s still building confidence in reading English may be too overwhelming right now.
What we’re really looking for is a school that offers:
 • Small class sizes
• Understanding/support for ADHD, neurodivergence, and emotional needs
• Structure, but not rigid pressure
• Freedom to move, explore, and learn in a more natural way
• Plenty of outdoor time / nature-based opportunities
• A nurturing environment that sees the whole child, not just behavior
We’re in the 281/1604 area but would be willing to drive 20–25 minutes for the right fit.
If your child sounds similar and you’ve found a school you love, I would be so grateful for recommendations. He would be entering Kindergarten
